comments.note: The pre-existing warnings originated in StubDbConnection.ConnectionString (~line 346) and StubDbCommand.CommandText (~line 374). Both override base properties whose setters accept string? in .NET 10, but the overrides declare string (non-nullable), causing CS8765. [AllowNull] is the idiomatic fix — it preserves the non-null return type while allowing nullable input via the setter, exactly matching the base contract.
